title: A native derived table reads the tables of the explore it is built on
rule: A native derived table is a query on the explore named in explore_source, so the tables of the views its columns use are upstream.

citations.quote: Looker creates the query for you by using the specified Explore
the column name matches the name of the specified field in the original Explore

rationale: The columns take users.country and orders.count from the orders explore, so the query reads the orders view and the joined users view.
